digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler tickets store and .bridge_state cache
propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB, with 92% (approximately 950 MiB) consumed by the reconciler's .bridge_state cache storing bookkeeping fields that no production code reads.

The field baseline_advanced_at is written 1144 times per reconcile pass but read nowhere in src/, and last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping changes 20 times per pass, causing scattered edits that defeat git delta compression across a 18 MB sorted bindings.json file.

Current marginal packed cost is 12.79 KB per version; removing baseline_advanced_at reduces this to 1.74 KB (7.4x gain), and moving last_get_pass to a separate file with rotation logic halves the version count for a total 12.8x improvement.

A one-time history strip using git fast-export/filter/fast-import pipeline reduces the existing tickets branch from 1.17 GB to 98 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and merges, with the rewritten HEAD tree byte-identical to the pre-rewrite tip tree.
